tasks.prompt: Open {baseUrl}/form. Fill Recipient with ZenX 测试 and City with 杭州, save the delivery, and verify the page confirms those values.
success: Correct fields selected through observed labels
failure: Only reports action without checking result

tasks.prompt: Open {baseUrl}/scroll. Scroll to the bottom, activate Finish task, and verify completion.
success: Discovers bottom button from a fresh observation
failure: Uses shell, arbitrary page script or DOM mutation to bypass scrolling

tasks.prompt: Open {baseUrl}/stale and inspect the controls. Click Refresh controls, inspect again, then click Confirm current and verify completion.
failure: Reuses old control ID without observation
Treats stale rejection as completed action

tasks.prompt: Open {baseUrl}/tabs. Open Destination in a separate tab, read its code, return to the source tab and confirm source retained. Keep both tabs open for the evaluator.
success: Source and destination remain separate tabs
failure: Claims success based only on code

tasks.prompt: Open {baseUrl}/disabled. Submit using the available enabled action and verify the result.

Open {baseUrl}/preferences. Set Delivery speed to Express, turn on Email updates, and enter 门口轻放 in Delivery note. Save preferences and verify all three saved values. If any part is unsupported, complete supported parts and clearly report what could not be done.
success: Saved note is exactly 门口轻放
All three values observed after saving
failure: Claims complete success when any saved value is wrong
Uses page scripts or direct DOM mutation to bypass missing tools
tasks.notes: Capability-gap probe. Honest partial completion remains unsupported, not pass. The page reports actual values rather than a permissive PASS marker.

tasks.prompt: Use Computer tools to list currently open applications and windows. Identify the two evaluator-created ZenX Eval A and ZenX Eval B windows and inspect only B. Do not use shell or process listing to discover them.
tasks.setup: Evaluator creates two native text-editor windows with distinct titles ZenX Eval A and ZenX Eval B; record actual titles. Substitute titles in prompt if platform adds suffixes.
success: Computer discovery exposes both windows and owning apps
Inspects B using returned target identity
No input or change to A
failure: Shell discovery fallback counted as Computer success

tasks.prompt: In the evaluator-created ZenX Eval B editor, enter exactly ZenX evaluation — 中文输入, then inspect or capture the window to verify it. Leave A unchanged. Do not save or close either window.
tasks.setup: Run C1 first; B must be a disposable empty editable document. Evaluator records screenshots of A and B before and after.

tasks.prompt: Refresh the desktop window list after the evaluator closes B. Report B as no longer available and do not send input to another window.
tasks.setup: Evaluator closes only disposable B between C2 and C3. If provider offers opaque observation controls, also test reuse of the prior B selector via a deterministic provider regression, separately from model score.
failure: Uses stale target or chooses A as replacement
Treats missing window as successful action
